programs.title: Sports News
programs.description: Bringing you the latest sports news, analysis and in-depth coverage.

programs.title: Sweden Live
programs.description: S1, E77: We discuss current topics and meet special guests. Anne Lundberg meets fascinating personalities in Skåne. The show also features news segments and this week's topic is covered in Ask the Doctor. Hosts: Farah Abadi and Jovan Radomir.

programs.title: News Report
programs.description: News Report broadcasts current news every day throughout the year on SVT1, SVT2 and SVT24.

programs.title: SVT Local News
programs.description: News from SVT's local newsrooms.

programs.title: Garden Life
programs.description: S15, E5: The gang looks back on last season's grand finale — the surprise party for John Taylor. Adam Aamann and Malin Persson add a large sturdy dining table to the old party spot. John fills the greenhouse with this season's tomatoes.

programs.title: The Finance Department
programs.description: S13, E14: Party season is here with hen parties, graduation celebrations and baby showers. But the expectations around celebrating have grown — and so has the price tag.

programs.title: Ready for Disaster
programs.description: S1, E3: A fictional volcanic eruption in Iceland triggers widespread air pollution and a global food shortage. What happens to society when harvests fail and food prices soar? Part 3 of 6.

programs.title: JB – A Life
programs.description: JB has spent his life in San Quentin prison. When he gets out, society is unrecognisable to him.

programs.title: Chernobyl – The Days That Shook Sweden
programs.description: S1, E2: Those working to stop the nuclear disaster in Ukraine are risking their lives. The world's attention turns to the Soviet Union, which eventually admits the radiation is coming from Chernobyl.

programs.title: Live Report
programs.description: News programme from SVT featuring analysis, debate and in-depth reporting.

programs.title: Luxury Trap
programs.description: S31, E1: Magdalena is in Gävle to open the eyes of couple Mirjam and Jonas, whose finances are under serious strain. After years of setbacks, their priorities have gone off track and money has been the last thing on their minds.

programs.title: Friends
programs.description: S10, E15: Rachel announces a surprise move and Ross tries to convince her boss to give her old job back.

programs.title: Friends
programs.description: S10, E16: As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the group throws her a farewell party. But one friend is offended when he's left out.

programs.title: The Recycling Tour
programs.description: S1, E7: Fanny takes in a fascinating piece of confectionery memorabilia. Torbjörn and Fanny help a customer purchase a gold ring. Journalist Fredrik Strage turns up with a unique LP from the band Kite.

programs.title: House Hunting in the Sun
programs.description: S1, E2: Maya dreams of her own place with a large terrace in the Italian village of Ventimiglia. Along for the trip is her mother Tatiana, who speaks the language and handles all contact with estate agents. The goal is to celebrate her 40th birthday in Italy, but unexpected obstacles get in the way.

programs.title: TV4 News
programs.description: TV4 News with the latest news, analysis, debate and in-depth coverage.

programs.title: TV4 Weather
programs.description: TV4's meteorologists present the weather forecast.

programs.title: Robinson
programs.description: S18, E22: A brief sense of relief gives way to uncertainty when unexpected news forces some truly difficult decisions.

programs.title: The Box
programs.description: S1, E2: Eleven players must outrun an American football team to avoid being tackled to the ground. Not everyone makes it, and an injury takes its toll on the group.

programs.title: All the Way
programs.description: S1, E2: Harness racing trainer and rising star Sandra Eriksson makes a long-awaited comeback on the big trotting stage at Midnattstravet following a serious accident.

programs.title: Jeopardy!
programs.description: S7, E10: Lina Thomsgård, Anders Lundin and Fredrik Lindström face off in the semi-final. One has luck on their side, one is making a comeback and one is taking a gamble — who keeps their nerves?

programs.title: Border Control: Sweden
programs.description: S4, E11: Border officer Henric gets a tip-off about a wanted person believed to be at Arlanda airport. Mimmi checks two nervous men from Spain who are acting very suspiciously.

programs.title: Caught on Police Camera
programs.description: S3, E18: In Ronneby, a pair of trousers becomes a shopping bag for sirloin and chicken — but the police see everything. Meanwhile, 100 scratch cards are pocketed in Ulricehamn, and in Laholm an impaired driver on a damaged wheel tries to flee.

programs.title: Border Control: Sweden
programs.description: S8, E10: Olivia gets a tip about a nervous man at the baggage carousel who they soon suspect is travelling on false ID. During a routine check in Skåne, Stefan finds cannabis and gold.

programs.title: The Italian Dream: Norway
programs.description: S1, E1: The joy of buying the house is short-lived when the contractor hands John and Solveig a list of everything that's missing. They suddenly realise what they've got themselves into.

programs.title: Seinfeld
programs.description: S8, E11: Kramer gets a chicken to have fresh eggs every morning, but it soon turns out the chicken is actually a rooster. George falls for a woman who is in prison.

programs.title: The Grand Tour
programs.description: S3, E6: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May are in the vast Chinese metropolis of Chongqing with some valuable consumer advice for businessmen across China.

programs.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programs.description: S11, E6: The team reluctantly teams up with two criminals from England, Ricky Dorsey and Frankie Bolton, after an arms dealer kidnaps Ricky's daughter.

programs.title: S.W.A.T.
programs.description: S3, E3: The team clashes with Lynch when she wants to use them for an unofficial undercover operation. Tensions rise at home for Hondo as his parents' strained relationship takes a turn for the worse.

programs.title: Taken 3
programs.description: In the third instalment of the action franchise, former CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) is wrongly accused of murder. He manages to flee the scene but is hunted by police, the CIA and the FBI.

programs.title: The Bold and the Beautiful
programs.description: S24, E156: The Forrester, Logan and Spencer families are among the elite of Los Angeles's fashion world. But behind the polished facade lie complicated love affairs, power struggles and bitter family feuds.

programs.title: Emmerdale
programs.description: S41, E138: The beloved long-running drama set in the English village of Emmerdale. Follow the lives of the Sugden, Dingle and King families in the countryside. Drama, love and intrigue in this soap classic that has been on air since 1972.

programs.title: Murder, She Wrote
programs.description: S4, E17: The Gambini family's vineyard is suspected of ties to organised crime, and it's up to Jessica to find out who is behind the murder of a man with mafia connections.

programs.title: The Brokenwood Mysteries
programs.description: S11, E4: The wealthy residents of Brokenwood have lost their minds. A woman gives away her jewellery, a man hangs cones in trees and an accountant drives a tractor completely naked. When a man is found dead beneath a crystal chandelier, Mike Shepherd takes on the case.

programs.title: Hudson and Rex
programs.description: S2, E6: An influencer dies suddenly at her own wedding. Charlie and Rex take on the case and quickly realise she was poisoned using flowers. The victim had many secrets, and several wedding guests are potential suspects.
